title: SMS Education for Post-operative Pain
brief_summary: The purpose the research is to assess whether or not postoperative education and awareness about pain and opioid use through SMS text messages will reduce overall opioid utilization after common outpatient surgeries.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients aged ≥18 who are undergoing outpatient surgery (admission \<23hrs) where opioids are typically prescribed

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English speaking patients.
* No access to cellphone.
* Admission beyond 24 hours.
